title: East Coast Severe Weather suburbs in impacted area - close 21 July
summary: Find information about the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance payment and the suburbs eligible for it.
intro:
To be eligible for the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance payment, you must live in one of the listed suburbs within the Impacted Area.

Applications for payment for the suburbs listed on this page close 21 July 2025.

See the list of eligible suburbs where applications close 4 August 2025.

The list of eligible suburbs may be updated from time to time. The most recent update was made on 14 July 2025.
